meta.name: llm-council
meta.description: Provider-agnostic multi-LLM deliberation. Three phases — independent responses, cross-model anonymized ranking, chairman synthesis. Provider config from env (OPENAI/ANTHROPIC/FIREWORKS/OPENROUTER/custom OpenAI-compatible base URL). Persists transcript to a wiki page when --wiki <slug> is passed. Use when the user wants multiple AI perspectives, consensus-building, or the "LLM Council" approach for high-stakes reviews, plan critique, or contested learning rules.

copy.tagline: 让多个大模型协作讨论，生成综合意见
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在重要决策前听取多个AI的不同观点并达成共识
copy.tagline_en: Run multi-LLM deliberation for consensus and critique
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multiple AI perspectives to reach consensus on high-stakes decisions

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会调用多个不同 AI 模型（如 GPT、Claude 等）分别回答你的问题，然后让这些模型匿名互相打分排序，最后选出一个“主席”模型综合所有意见给出最终答案。整个过程会保存详细记录。
howto.when: 当你要求进行高风险的方案评审、解决冲突的学习规则，或直接输入 /council "你的问题" 时触发。

say.text: /council "这个新功能方案有哪些潜在风险？"
say.note: 启动多模型评审，获得多角度分析。

say.text: /wiki council 学习规则冲突 "如何统一两个矛盾的学习策略？"
say.note: 结合 wiki 上下文进行多模型讨论并保存记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will call multiple different AI models (e.g., GPT, Claude) to answer your question independently, then have them anonymously rank each other's responses, and finally a designated chairman model synthesizes all opinions into a final answer. The full transcript is saved.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request high-stakes plan review, conflicting learning rules resolution, or directly invoke /council "<query>" or /wiki council.

say_en.text: /council "What are the potential risks of this new feature plan?"
say_en.note: Launches multi-model review for diverse perspectives.

say_en.text: /wiki council learning-rule conflict "How to unify two contradictory learning strategies?"
say_en.note: Runs council with wiki context and persists transcript.
